issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

userRoles.description: Roles that are going to receive the email notification.

sections.description:
Sections which will be used to build the content of the email notification. These are strings that correspond to
types that implement the {@link ReliabilityEmailUpdateNotificationSection} interface. The order of the array
matters.

notificationCategory.description:
Category of the email notification to be used in {@link NotificationSpec#category}. For more information about the
possible categories, @see NotificationCategoryEnum

batchPeriodHours.description:
Configurable batch period to use for the {@link ReliabilityEmailUpdateNotificationScheduler}. Represents the time
span, in hours, used to construct the email notification in order to include only the data points that have been
created within this specified period. This must be referenced in the implementations of
{@link ReliabilityEmailUpdateNotificationSection#buildContent}.
